payload.taskDescription: First real publish on 2026-11-26: a drafted, edited and approved post went out to the Page at its scheduled minute (22:10 Europe/Copenhagen, sent seven seconds past), with external id and permalink recorded, the link shown as a preview card, and no error in the log. Seen on the Page by the owner. Still open: visibility from a signed-out browser while the Meta app is in Development mode, what Live mode requires, photo posts and deletion.
